accessibility.accessibleNameSource: label prop (default "pagination"). Give each pagination on a page a distinct label.
aria: root: native nav landmark with aria-label
content: role=list; item: role=listitem (set on the hosts, which resolve across the shadow roots in the flat tree)
link: native a; the current page has aria-current="page"

previous and next: named by the slotted text when no label is set (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name); an explicit label becomes the aria-label; with no slotted text the name is "Go to previous page" / "Go to next page"
ellipsis: aria-hidden, decorative; "More pages" stays in the DOM as visually hidden text
sb-pagination-content and sb-pagination-item set role=list and role=listitem only when the author set no role

keyboard.Tab: moves through the links in order

antiPatterns.why: They are not links: no keyboard focus and no navigation

antiPatterns.alternative: Set a distinct label on each
antiPatterns.pattern: Two paginations on one page with the same label
antiPatterns.why: Screen reader users cannot tell the landmarks apart

useCases.use: sb-pagination with previous, links, ellipsis and next
useCases.when: A list or table split over several pages

plan:
# Plan: Pagination (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
Seven elements: `sb-pagination`, `-content`, `-item`, `-link`, `-previous`, `-next`, `-ellipsis`. Out of scope: computing page ranges, page-size selectors, disabled previous and next.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/pagination/Pagination.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/pagination/pagination.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/pagination/Pagination.scss` -> `Pagination.styles.ts` (generated, shared) |
| 4 | one `.ts` per element, `index.ts` |

## Test plan (test-first)
- Navigation landmark name; list and list items; links with hrefs.
- `active` sets aria-current and the outlined look; previous and next names and visible text; ellipsis hidden from assistive technology.
- Sizes, hover colors from tokens, keyboard order and Enter, keyboard-only focus ring, forwarded aria-label, mirrored chevrons in right-to-left, axe.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
- 3px solid focus ring; the ellipsis words are hidden from assistive technology, as in the reference.

## Open questions (recommendation first)
All three answered with the recommendation: own anchor instead of sb-button; ellipsis aria-hidden; roles on the hosts.
